comparison_rule: Compare on the same supported deployment; no native versus RDF speedup; external API calls are not assumed one per case
sota_scope: Cite component evidence and benchmark scope; composition is not itself claimed to be an author-published SOTA system

scope_reporting.rule: Record capability, transport, model-format, timeout, answer quality separately; single-source-only support requires evidence, not inference from a formatter failure. No added baseline federation capability.
scope_reporting.supported_runtime_failures: Keep in the corresponding stratum denominator
